reason_not_in.cursor: Cursor has no permission events a hook can see.

relay.does: Internal. The prompts that wait in other chats, for the coordinator's mod (next, pick, again).

does: Shows the coordinator the permission prompts and auto mode blocks that wait in other chats, with a button that opens that chat's tab. It approves nothing.

children.does: Records each permission prompt that waits in another chat. The record goes when the prompt is answered, its turn ends or the chat ends.
Also lists calls that auto mode blocked. They stay until you keep them blocked, the chat ends or an hour passes.
How many characters of the command the dialog shows. 0 shows only the chat and the tool.
The coordinator shows one dialog at a time, and only while its prompt box is idle.
Open the tab brings the waiting chat's tab or pane to the front. It never types there.
Refuses tool calls that read, search or write the relay folder, so a prompt's text never reaches a model.
